_about: Public-domain Ebenezer Erskine (1680-1754, Stirling) and his brother Ralph Erskine (1685-1752, Dunfermline), founders of the Secession Church, on one shelf for the Word Hoard. Ebenezer's Whole Works (Edinburgh, 1871, 3 vols) and Ralph's Sermons and Other Practical Works (London: Tegg, 1865, 7 vols), raw Internet Archive OCR; volume numbers read off the title pages. Ralph's Gospel Sonnets are verse: in his Works here, and for the hymn manifest if wanted as hymns. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
